mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a novel where colonial ideology is manifested in Crusoe's colonialist attitude towards the land upon which he's shipwrecked and toward the Blackman he 'colonises' and names Friday."

Daniel Defoe's Robinson Crusoe is a novel where colonial ideology is manifested in Crusoe's colonialist attitude towards the land upon which he's shipwrecked and toward the Blackman he 'colonises' and names Friday.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dream for psychoanalytic critics."
Naturally Conrad is a dream for psychoanalytic critics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a literary approach that gives a kind of psychological relief to the people (the colonised) for whom it was born."
Post-colonialism is a literary approach that gives a kind of psychological relief to the people (the colonised) for whom it was born.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a leading voice in postcolonial studies and is highly influenced by Western poststructuralists' theorists, notably Jacques Derrida, Jacques Lacan and Michael Foucault."
Homi Bhabha is a leading voice in postcolonial studies and is highly influenced by Western poststructuralists' theorists, notably Jacques Derrida, Jacques Lacan and Michael Foucault.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a compulsive thief who steals not to build a house or make a fortune but to feast people erratically."
Johnson is a compulsive thief who steals not to build a house or make a fortune but to feast people erratically.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an abiku child, which means a child born to die in Yoruba cosmology."
Azaro is an abiku child, which means a child born to die in Yoruba cosmology.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the protagonist and main subject of Cary's novel."
Johnson and Nigeria are the protagonist and main subject of Cary's novel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with literature produced by colonial powers and works produced by those who were/are colonised."
Postcolonial critics are concerned with literature produced by colonial powers and works produced by those who were/are colonised.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a parody of the Christian myth of sacrifice and at the same time anticipates poetic justice for the devils of neo-colonialism."
The novel's title is a parody of the Christian myth of sacrifice and at the same time anticipates poetic justice for the devils of neo-colonialism.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a literary movement associated with a narrative mode that combines realism and the fantastic so that the marvelous seems to grow organically within the ordinary, blurring the distinction between them."

Magical realism is defined as a literary movement associated with a narrative mode that combines realism and the fantastic so that the marvelous seems to grow organically within the ordinary, blurring the distinction between them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a perfect example for the spirit of the time it was written in."
Robinson Crusoe is a perfect example for the spirit of the time it was written in.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an object of knowledge defined by a regime of truth and regulated by relations of force and power."
Discourse is an object of knowledge defined by a regime of truth and regulated by relations of force and power.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the writing which runs from about five hundred years, through the days of European mercantile expansion, to the contemporary time."
Colonial Discourse refers to the writing which runs from about five hundred years, through the days of European mercantile expansion, to the contemporary time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the co-existence and interdependence of two contrary impulses or effects."
Ambivalence refers to the co-existence and interdependence of two contrary impulses or effects.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fictional riposte to Defoe's classic."
Coetzee's Foe is a fictional riposte to Defoe's classic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most widely known, and controversial, intellectuals in the world today."
Said is one of the most widely known, and controversial, intellectuals in the world today.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a powerful, usually destructive historical force that shapes not only the political futures of the countries involved but also the identities of colonised and colonising people."
Colonialism is a powerful, usually destructive historical force that shapes not only the political futures of the countries involved but also the identities of colonised and colonising people.
